definition: זֵרוּעַ noun [masculine] sowing, thing sown (intensive formative according to Ol § 186 b Sta § 228 , yet on this and following compare Ba NB 42, 178 Anm. 4 ) — ׳ זֶרַע ז Lev 11:37 ( P ), כְּגַנָּה זֵָֽרוּעֶיהָ תַצְמִיךְַ Isa 61:11 in simile of Yahweh's causing righteousness to spring up.

זֵרוּעַ noun [masculine] sowing, thing sown (intensive formative according to Ol§ 186 b Sta§ 228, yet on this and following compare BaNB 42, 178 Anm. 4) — ׳זֶרַע ז Lev 11:37 (P), כְּגַנָּה זֵָֽרוּעֶיהָ תַצְמִיךְַ Isa 61:11 in simile of Yahweh's causing righteousness to spring up.
